summary: A multi-level, jungle-themed rooftop on T-One’s upper floors, known for its illuminated bamboo canopy, skyline views, DJs and lively crowd. Treat it as a photogenic social stop rather than a quiet, seated cocktail bar.
whyGo: See the glowing bamboo installation and Bangkok skyline from a busy open-air terrace.
Enjoy DJs and cocktails in Thonglor, with no cover charge reported by the venue.
bestFor: Groups and couples seeking a lively rooftop drink
skipIf: You want a quiet conversation, guaranteed table, or low-cost drinks
You are under 20 or cannot bring an original passport for entry
duration: Allow about 1–2 hours, plus possible queue time; planning estimate.
cost: Venue FAQ says entry is free. Budget roughly ฿380–500 per cocktail based on recent listed examples and 2026 visitor price reports; confirm menu and any service/tax charges on arrival. No confirmed December 2026 event package or minimum spend found.
hours: Venue FAQ: daily from 17:00 until late. The Tourism Authority of Thailand lists 17:00–24:00, with Sunday to 22:00; hours may change, so check the venue’s social media close to your visit.
bestTime: Arrive near opening for the best chance of avoiding a long queue and catching dusk; expect a busy, photo-focused atmosphere later. Queue timing is reported by a recent local guide, not guaranteed.
gettingThere: Take the BTS Sukhumvit Line to Thong Lo and walk to T-One Building, Soi Sukhumvit 40 (about 320 m / roughly 5–10 minutes, depending on route). The venue says it is on the 46th floor; follow signs in the lobby. Official address: T-One Building, Soi Sukhumvit 40, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110.
booking: The venue says it accepts walk-ins only; there is no standard table reservation. It is for guests aged 20+. Foreign visitors must show their original physical passport; a photo, copy or digital passport is not accepted. Carry it. The venue reports free entry; confirm any special-event terms for your date.
accessibility: Venue materials confirm lifts to the rooftop floors, but do not describe step-free access, accessible toilets or assistance. A local guide reports open-air stairs between terrace levels and a lift that only reaches floor 40 before a second lift; ask the venue about your access needs in advance.
practicalTips: Dress smart casual if you like, though a local guide reports no enforced dress code; the crowd often dresses for photos.
Bring an original passport and allow time for bag security screening.
Photography is allowed for personal use; the venue asks guests to respect others. Commercial shoots need prior approval.
Check the venue’s Instagram for DJ lineups and special performances.
decemberNotes: No December 2026-specific event or special schedule was confirmed as of 17 October 2026. Rooftop weather and operating hours can vary; check the venue’s own channels on the day, especially around year-end.
uncertainties: Official opening hours are given as ‘until late’; the Tourism Authority listing has a more specific schedule, which may be outdated.
The venue does not publish a readily verifiable current full drink menu online; quoted cocktail spend is a planning range, not a guaranteed price.
Step-free access, lift operation during busy periods, and accessible facilities are not documented in the sources reviewed.
Photo reference is editorial and linked for reference; reuse permission has not been established.
